title: Patched up
blurb: A cut arm, a burned hand, and a healer's back room. Bind a wound, dress a burn.
after: Wounds in this world bleed, burn and fester, and what treats them is real: cloth, herbs, clean water. Helping someone is remembered.
refines: Do players find their wounds and Treat in Pack & gear? Do the remedies get made and recognised whatever they're called?
goal: Bind your cut, then help Tam

npc_brea_healer.goal: keep the back room in order

things.name: clean linen cloth
things.description: A folded square of clean, boiled linen, soft and white.

things.name: plantain leaves
things.description: A handful of broad, ribbed plantain leaves, fresh from the yard.

things.name: wooden bowl
things.description: A shallow wooden bowl for mixing herbs.

things.name: stone pestle
things.description: A smooth stone pestle for crushing herbs.

steps.title: A cut
cards: …signal. You've cut your arm on a nail by the inn's back door. Not deep, but it's bleeding.
This is Mother Brea's room: she patches up everyone on this road. Wounds here are real, and so are the ways to treat them.

on_start.text: Mind that nail! Oh, dearie, you've cut yourself. Come in, come in.

steps.title: Your wounds
cards: Press {I}. Pack & gear shows your health and your wounds: what each is, how bad, and what can treat it.
A cut bleeds until it's bound. A burn needs dressing. Left alone, wounds fester.
steps.task: Press I and look at your wounds

steps.title: Ask for help
cards: Ask Brea what you can use. She knows every herb and bandage there is.

suggest.text: Could I use some of your linen to bind this cut?

on_done.text: Use what's on the table, dearie: clean linen, and my plantain if you need it. Tear a strip, bind it tight.

steps.done: She's lent you her things: using them isn't stealing.

playtest.say: Could I use some of your linen to bind this cut?

steps.title: A bandage
cards: Make a bandage from the clean linen: press {T}, {Tab} to DO, and say what you do.

suggest.text: tear the clean linen into a strip to make a bandage

steps.task: Make a bandage from the linen
steps.done: A bandage: the game knows what it's for, whatever you called it.
help: Stand by the table with the linen, press {T}, {Tab} to DO, and type 'tear the linen into a strip for a bandage'.

playtest.do: tear the clean linen into a strip to make a bandage

try_also: make a bandage out of the linen cloth

steps.title: Treat yourself
cards: Now bind your cut. In Pack & gear ({I}), press Treat beside the cut. Or drag the bandage onto yourself.
steps.done: Bound. It'll stop bleeding now. Treatment takes your hands for a moment: mind that in a fight.
help: Press {I}, find the cut under your wounds, and press Treat.

steps.title: A burn

on_start.text: Ow! Blast that stove! My hand!
Tam! Again? Don't put it in your mouth, you lump.

cards: Tam the drover has burned his hand on the stove. Go to him.
steps.done: A bad burn. It needs dressing.

steps.title: Something for a burn
cards: Plantain is good for burns: crush the leaves into a poultice. Try this:

suggest.text: crush the plantain leaves in the bowl into a poultice for a burn

steps.task: Make a poultice from the plantain
steps.done: A poultice. Now it needs to go on his hand.
help: Stand by the plantain (or carry it), press {T}, {Tab} to DO, and type 'crush the plantain leaves into a poultice for a burn'.

playtest.do: crush the plantain leaves in the bowl into a poultice for a burn

try_also: mash the plantain into a poultice

steps.title: Treat someone else
cards: Put the poultice on Tam's burn: drag it from your pack onto him, or say what you do.

suggest.text: lay the poultice on Tam's burned hand

steps.task: Put the poultice on Tam's burn

on_done.text: Ahh, that's cool. Thank you kindly. Brea, did you see? Saved my hand.
Not bad, dearie. If you're heading up the river, Ulf the charcoal burner could use a hand that knows fire.

on_done.lead: Ulf the charcoal burner up the river could use help with fire and water.
on_done.said: Ulf the charcoal burner could use a hand that knows fire.

steps.done: People remember who helped them. Tam will talk about this.
help: Walk up to Tam, drag the poultice onto him and press {Enter}.

playtest.do: lay the poultice on Tam's burned hand

try_also: put the plantain poultice on Tam's hand

steps.title: If it goes wrong
cards: One more thing. Mistakes here are real: a bad fight, a theft, a death.
If something goes badly wrong, Rewind to the last calm moment takes you back. It's in the menu ({Esc}), and on the card if you die.
steps.done: That's wounds. Look after yourself out there.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
